title: City of 11,000 structures found in Ecuadorian jungle

tellings.quote: They they found a city I think with 11,000 structures

plain: A lost city of about 11,000 structures is said to have been found in the jungle of the Ecuadorian Amazon. A researcher named Luke Caverns mentions it in passing on the podcast, hedging that he thinks that is the number, and gives no further detail. If true, it would mean large ancient societies lived in places long thought to be empty wilderness.
